label: GOD_4 HAS_INTELLECT_1 from good-general apprehension at the root and finite reach
description: Some n is an actual concrete root at w. Take any g that is GOD_4. Finite grounding reach makes g a grounding ancestor of the actual concretum n; since n has no actual concrete ground, the path is trivial and g = n (namedRootOfReach). The root-level premise gives n a good-general favouring and an apprehended content, and the recognition bridge gives g HAS_INTELLECT_1. Neither the q.14 immateriality premise nor every-pure-perfection (fe67d766) nor the #2153 E premise is used. The main theorem uses no axioms. The Comparator companion intellectStepControls (propext, Quot.sound; same carrier) gives a positive witness and, for three of the four premises, a row where it fails, the others hold and GOD_4 HAS_INTELLECT_1 fails: the D-directed root fails the root-level premise, GOD_4 naming the effect fails reach, and the recognition bridge fails without the HasIntellect predicate. Root existence holds on every assignment of this carrier.
